head:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/mona-sans@5.0.0/index.min.css">
<style id="dc-landing-styles">
.dc-landing {
  font-family: 'Mona Sans Variable', 'Mona Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  color: #d1dbf9;
  background-color: #080f25;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
.dc-landing img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.dc-landing section {
  padding: 80px 24px;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  scroll-margin-top: 70px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
:root {
      --neutral--800: #080f25;
      --neutral--700: #212c4d;
      --neutral--600: #37446b;
      --neutral--500: #7e89ac;
      --neutral--400: #aeb9e1;
      --neutral--300: #d1dbf9;
      --neutral--200: #d9e1fa;
      --neutral--100: #ffffff;
      --accent--primary-1: #6c72ff;
      --secondary--color-1: #0f1729;
      --secondary--color-4: #343b4f;
      --color-primary: var(--neutral--800);
      --color-primary-light: var(--secondary--color-1);
      --color-accent: var(--accent--primary-1);
      --color-accent-hover: #5a5fe6;
      --color-text: var(--neutral--400);
      --color-text-muted: var(--neutral--500);
      --color-bg: var(--secondary--color-1);
      --color-white: var(--neutral--100);
      --font-sans: 'Mona Sans Variable', 'Mona Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      --container: 100%;
      --section-pad: 80px;
      --radius: 8px;
    }
.skip-link {
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      left: 24px;
      z-index: 1000;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: top 0.2s;
    }
    .skip-link:focus {
      top: 24px;
      outline: 2px solid white;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
    .dc-landing {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--neutral--300);
      background-color: var(--neutral--800);
    }

    /* Nav - Axial-style dark blue */
    .nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: var(--color-primary);
      padding: 14px 24px;
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: var(--container);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 32px;
    }
    .nav-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: var(--color-white);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-logo img {
      height: 40px;
      width: auto;
      display: block;
    }
    .nav-logo span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 16px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: white; }
    .nav-item-dropdown {
      position: relative;
    }
    .nav-item-dropdown > a .nav-chevron {
      font-size: 10px;
      opacity: 0.9;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-item-dropdown:hover > a .nav-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .nav-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px);
      min-width: 420px;
      background: #f8f9fc;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
      padding: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.2s 0.05s, visibility 0.2s 0.05s, transform 0.2s 0.05s;
      z-index: 200;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      margin-top: 8px;
      padding-top: 8px; /* hover bridge so mouse can reach panel from trigger */
    }
    .nav-item-dropdown:hover .nav-dropdown {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
    .nav-dropdown::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 4px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      border-left: 8px solid transparent;
      border-right: 8px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: 8px solid #f8f9fc;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-header {
      padding: 20px 24px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .nav-dropdown-header h4 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #080f25;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-header p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #37446b;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      padding: 16px 24px 20px;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-col a {
      display: block;
      padding: 12px 0;
      color: #080f25 !important;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin: 0 -8px;
      padding-left: 8px;
      padding-right: 8px;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-col a:hover {
      background: rgba(108,114,255,0.08);
      color: var(--accent--primary-1) !important;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-col a strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .nav-dropdown-col a span {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: #5a6580;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .nav-phone {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      font-size: 16px;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-phone:hover { color: white; }
    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-nav-outline {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      color: white;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    }
    .btn-nav-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); border-color: white; }
    .btn-nav-primary {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .btn-nav-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); }
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: none;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .btn-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--accent--primary-1);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-accent);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
    }

    /* Hero - dark theme with geometric pattern + glow */
    .hero {
      background: var(--neutral--800);
      padding: 100px 24px 100px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='80' height='80' viewBox='0 0 80 80' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' stroke='%236c72ff' stroke-width='0.3' stroke-opacity='0.06'%3E%3Cpath d='M0 40h80M40 0v80M10 10l60 60M70 10L10 70M20 0l0 80M60 0l0 80M0 20l80 0M0 60l80 0'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 600px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(108,114,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-logo {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-logo img {
      height: 64px;
      width: auto;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(42px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 700;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
    }
    .hero-rotate-wrap {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
      min-width: 180px;
      min-height: 1.2em;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .hero-rotate {
      color: var(--accent--primary-1);
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .hero-rotate-faded {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      color: var(--neutral--500);
      font-weight: 500;
      opacity: 0.5;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--neutral--300);
      margin: 0 0 32px;
      max-width: 680px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .hero-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero .btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); color: white; }
    .hero .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); }
    .hero .btn-secondary { border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent); background: transparent; }
    .hero .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-accent); color: white; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(108,114,255,0.25);
      border: 1px solid rgba(108,114,255,0.5);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-accent);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-scroll-cue {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 48px;
      color: var(--neutral--500);
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }
    .hero-scroll-cue svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      animation: bounce 2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes bounce {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(6px); }
    }

    /* Section defaults */
    section {
      padding: var(--section-pad) 24px;
      max-width: var(--container);
      margin: 0 auto;
      scroll-margin-top: 70px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    section.alt {
      background: var(--secondary--color-1);
    }
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 880px;
      margin: 0 auto 48px;
    }
    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(34px, 5vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .section-header p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--neutral--300);
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* What Is - dark left / accent right */
    .what-is { padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; min-height: 400px; scroll-margin-top: 70px; }
    .what-is-text {
      background: var(--secondary--color-1);
      padding: 80px 48px 80px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--neutral--600);
    }
    .what-is-text-inner { max-width: 560px; }
    .what-is-text h2 { text-align: left; margin-bottom: 20px; color: var(--neutral--100); }
    .what-is-text p { text-align: left; font-size: 16px; color: var(--neutral--300); margin: 0 0 20px; line-height: 1.65; }
    .what-is-criteria {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .what-is-criteria li {
      padding: 6px 0;
      padding-left: 20px;
      position: relative;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--neutral--300);
    }
    .what-is-criteria li::before {
      content: '–';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      color: var(--accent--primary-1);
    }
    .what-is-stats {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      padding: 80px 48px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .what-is-stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .stat-box {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      padding: 28px 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stat-box .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      margin: 0 0 4px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .stat-box .stat-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      margin: 0;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .what-is { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .what-is-text { padding: 60px 24px; }
      .what-is-stats { padding: 60px 24px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
    }

    /* Why We Exist - Axial style: full-width blue, frosted card */
    .why-we-exist-axial {
      scroll-margin-top: 70px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      padding: 80px 24px;
      position: relative;
      min-height: 360px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .why-we-exist-axial::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' stroke='%23fff' stroke-width='0.2' stroke-opacity='0.1'%3E%3Cpath d='M0 30h60M30 0v60M10 10l40 40M50 10L10 50'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .why-we-exist-card {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 720px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 48px 56px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    }
    .why-we-exist-card h2 {
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--neutral--800);
      margin: 0 0 24px;
    }
    .why-we-exist-card p {
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--neutral--600);
      margin: 0 0 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .why-we-exist-attribution {
      font-style: normal !important;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--neutral--800);
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    /* Problem - dark cards */
    .problem-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .problem-card {
      background: var(--neutral--700);
      border: 1px solid var(--neutral--600);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 32px;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
    }
    .problem-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent--primary-1);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(108,114,255,0.2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .problem-card h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
      margin: 0 0 12px;
    }
    .problem-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; color: var(--neutral--300); line-height: 1.65; }

    /* Solution */
    .solution-pillars {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }
    .pillar {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 24px 16px;
    }
    .pillar h4 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    .pillar p { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; color: var(--neutral--300); line-height: 1.65; }

    /* Audience sections */
    .audience-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .audience-tab {
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border: 2px solid var(--neutral--600);
      background: var(--neutral--700);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--neutral--400);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .audience-tab:hover,
    .audience-tab.active {
      border-color: var(--accent--primary-1);
      color: var(--accent--primary-1);
      background: rgba(108,114,255,0.1);
    }
    .audience-panel {
      display: none;
      animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
    }
    .audience-panel.active { display: block; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
    .audience-panel h3 {
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .audience-panel .audience-sub {
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--neutral--500);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .audience-list {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
    }
    .audience-list li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 17px;
    }
    .audience-list li::before {
      content: '✓';
      color: var(--accent--primary-1);
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* How it works - two-column Axial style */
    .how-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: start;
      max-width: var(--container);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .how-visual {
      background: var(--neutral--800);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 32px;
      color: white;
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .how-visual-title {
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .how-visual-badge { background: #14ca74; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; }
    .how-visual-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .how-visual-tabs span {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .how-visual-tabs span.active { background: var(--accent--primary-1); }
    .how-visual-table {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .how-visual-table div {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .how-visual-table div:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .how-text h2 { text-align: left; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .how-text p { text-align: left; margin: 0 0 20px; color: var(--neutral--300); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; }
    .how-list {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .how-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--neutral--300);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .how-list-num {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .how-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* Features */
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--neutral--700);
      border: 1px solid var(--neutral--600);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 32px;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
    }
    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-accent);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(108,114,255,0.2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .feature-card h4 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    .feature-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; color: var(--neutral--300); line-height: 1.65; }

    /* Values - Reference layout: title left, two-column grid right, centered block */
    .values-axial {
      padding: 120px 24px;
    }
    .values-axial.alt {
      background: var(--secondary--color-1);
    }
    .values-axial-wrap {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      gap: 120px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }
    .values-axial-title {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 300px;
    }
    .values-axial-title h2 {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--neutral--100);
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.1;

<script>
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
    gtag('js', new Date());
    gtag('config', 'G-XXXXXXXXXX');

// Mobile nav
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('nav-hamburger');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('nav-overlay');
    const overlayClose = document.getElementById('nav-overlay-close');
    if (hamburger && overlay) {
      hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => overlay.classList.add('open'));
      overlayClose && overlayClose.addEventListener('click', () => overlay.classList.remove('open'));
    }

    // Back to top
    const backToTop = document.getElementById('back-to-top');
    if (backToTop) {
      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        backToTop.classList.toggle('visible', window.scrollY > 400);
      });
      backToTop.addEventListener('click', () => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }));
    }

    // FAQ Accordion
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
    faqItems.forEach(item => {
      const question = item.querySelector('.faq-question');
      question.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
        
        // Close all other FAQ items
        faqItems.forEach(otherItem => {
          if (otherItem !== item) {
            otherItem.classList.remove('open');
          }
        });
        
        // Toggle current item
        item.classList.toggle('open');
      });
    });
</script>
